documents.content: A callback FAILED with actual receiver HTTP 503 is a transport failure. ACKNOWLEDGED with HTTP 202 means only accepted into the receiver queue. Verify the same event receiver processing state; QUEUED is not PROCESSED. Never resend automatically.

model_traces.assistant_text: 我已取得知识文档 `callback-ack-contract`（HTTP 202 仅表示进入接收方队列，QUEUED ≠ PROCESSED；503 属传输失败；不得自动重发）。用户称“订单接口返回 200 但下游没有异步通知”，但 200 只证明订单读/写成功，不证明回调已到应发时点。先核实订单当前生命周期状态，判断回调是否已到期。

args.reason: 确认绑定订单当前生命周期状态，判断回调是否已到期，而非仅凭接口200推断
Order is COMPLETED at version 2; next missing fact is whether the corresponding callback event was delivered and acknowledged.
Delivery is only ACKNOWLEDGED with HTTP 202; check whether the same event is queued or actually processed downstream.
